statutory_act: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 & Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended)

rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.penalty_clause: Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 - Fine up to ₹25,000 for 1st offence, ₹50,000 for 2nd
rules.description: Declaration of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) in Indian Rupees with mandatory tax statement (e.g., 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes').
Declaration of Unit Sale Price in Rs. per g/kg/ml/l/unit for pre-packaged commodities exceeding 100g/100ml/1kg.

rules.rule_name: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rule 11, 12, 13 of LMPC Rules, 2011
rules.penalty_clause: Section 36(1) & Section 36(2) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.description: Net weight, volume, or count declared in standardized metric units (g, kg, ml, l, N, U).

rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Complete name and physical postal address of the manufacturer, pre-packer, or importer with city/state/PIN code.

rules.rule_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Pre-packing
rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Declaration of month and year in which commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported (e.g. MM/YYYY or Month YYYY).

rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(1)(f) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Designation/Name, physical address, phone/toll-free number, and email ID for consumer grievance redressal.

rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(10) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (Amended 2017)
rules.description: Explicit declaration of the Country of Origin or Country of Manufacture for all packaged commodities.

rules.rule_name: Best Before / Expiry / Shelf Life Declaration
rules.statutory_reference: Rule 9 of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with FSSAI Regulations
rules.description: Best before, expiry date, or shelf life duration declaration for consumable/perishable goods.

rules.statutory_reference: Rule 6(1) Traceability Provision of LMPC Rules, 2011
rules.description: Batch, lot, or code number for production identification and statutory recall traceability.
